title: Operator graceful eviction during Helm upgrades and tenant-state guardian
creator: Maya Chen
description: Several Private customers reported that an operator-initiated Helm upgrade caused long-running tenant controller stalls and KV cache divergence for a subset of tenants. Customers saw stuck upgrade state (helmRelease pending) with nodeagent restarts and eviction storms when the control-plane attempted to reconcile resource deletes. This ticket owns a short-term automated mitigation and a medium-term guardian feature that safely snapshots tenant state before disruptive Helm hooks and allows graceful eviction + rollback if preflight checks fail.
background: Incidents observed 2025-02-27 through 2025-02-28 across three on-prem clusters. Root cause chain: 1) Helm post-upgrade hooks trigger bloaty manifest replacements for tenant ConfigMaps; 2) operator pods attempt parallel reconcilers that create transient pod churn; 3) kubelet eviction thresholds were reached on densified nodes causing nodeagent restarts; 4) operator leader election flapped and reconciliation gaps allowed KV cache divergence. Existing hotfixes address individual symptoms but we need a structured guard to avoid tenant-level data drift and lengthy customer escalations.
reproduction_steps: 1) Use a Private cluster with 20 tenants and simulated small-node capacity. 2) Apply a helm chart that updates tenant ConfigMap schema and triggers post-upgrade mutating hooks. 3) Simultaneously launch a reconciliation job that forces a manifest reapply. 4) Observe increased pod churn, node memory pressure, and operator leader handoffs. 5) Verify that some tenants have missing ephemeral keys in operator KV and that helmRelease remains Pending.
impact: Affected customers experience tenant-specific API errors, elevated latency, and in some cases inability to progress upgrades for hours. Customer support escalations and emergency rollbacks were required for two customers with regulatory requirements. Broad impact: medium cluster-level, high customer-level for those tenants.
mitigation_done: - Applied temporary rate-limiter to operator reconcile loops in prod clusters 2025-03-01. - Deployed a node-level eviction threshold adjustment for impacted clusters to reduce automatic pod eviction during mitigation window. - Ran a manual snapshot of tenant KV for the two escalated customers and restored missing entries. - Notified customers and opened support cases with step-by-step mitigation notes.
proposed_fix:
Phase A (short term): Implement an "upgrade pre-snapshot" feature in the operator that creates an atomic tenant-state snapshot (manifests + KV checkpoint) and holds disruptive Helm hooks behind a controllable preflight gate. Add an interruptible reconcile semaphore to limit parallel reconcilers per tenant to 1 and backoff on leader election events.
Phase B (medium-term): Add a Tenant-State Guardian controller that validates post-upgrade state against snapshot diffs, auto-rolls-back a helmRelease if divergence exceeds safe thresholds, and surfaces a targeted remediation runbook link in the Console.
acceptance_criteria:
- Operator creates and stores tenant-state snapshots for upgrades and attaches audit IDs (unit test and e2e).
- Helm upgrades may be run with preflight gate toggled; disruptive hooks will be held until snapshot success is confirmed.
- In a simulated degenerate cluster the operator prevents simultaneous reconciles and avoids node eviction cascade in >95% of runs.
- Rollback path must restore KV entries and manifest set to snapshot within 15 minutes in staging (validated by e2e).
- Documentation and runbook published and linked in Console for affected customers.
rollout_plan:
1) Merge operator pre-snapshot PR to canary cluster and run full regression suite (48h).
2) Enable in a single low-risk customer cluster behind feature flag for 72h.
3) Monitor metrics and error rates; if stable, enable progressively across Dedicated clusters.
4) For Private on-prem customers, ship operator v2025.03 with opt-in flag and provide an automated preflight run tool in the upgrade CLI.
5) Communicate to customers and solutions engineers with a rollback checklist.
monitoring_and_alerts:
Create these new monitors: - tenant.snapshot.failure.rate > 0.5% sustained -> Pager and Slack #onprem-ops.
- operator.reconcile.queue-depth per-tenant > 3 -> Platform alert, SE triage.
- helmRelease.rollback-triggered -> Ops alert and auto-created support ticket.
Add dashboards: Tenant Snapshot Success Rate, Reconcile Concurrency, KV Divergence Count. Link: https://dashboards.redwood.local/d/upgrade-guardian
